content.outro: The lamp catches, and the coast has its star back.
content.premise: The Tidewatch has burned every night for as long as the coast has had ships. Tonight it is dark, and the keeper who tends it is on the shore below with an empty oil jar and no way back up. Two wardens land on the tide stair, find what she needs, and climb the tower to put the light back in the window before the tide turns.
content.theme: A coastal watchtower whose lamp has gone out, and the tide-cut shore beneath it.
content.title: The Tidewatch
